what: Arm A (canx_chaperone_coupling): adding log2(CANX_KO_DMSO) to unpenalized Parental log2(DMSO) OLS to predict Parental log2(VX-661+VX-445) on 67 held-out Tedman et al. 2025 variants (59 residue clusters); required >=10% log2 MAE reduction and Bonferroni 97.5% CI strictly > 0.
why: Holdout MAE dropped only 4.59% (0.451487 to 0.430771 log2 units, rel=0.045884 < 0.10) and Bonferroni 97.5% cluster-bootstrap CI straddled zero [-0.001739, 0.044782] amid extreme Parental/CANX KO DMSO collinearity (r=0.992301 on dev). Standing: refuted.

what: Arm B (canx_ko_single_corrector_selectivity): partial-penalized Ridge (unpenalized CANX_KO_DMSO + CV-selected domain/class weights, alpha=100.0) predicting dampened S_eps_canx_ko = log2((VX445+0.05)/(VX661+0.05)) vs dev-CV-locked constant_dev_median (-0.108261) on 67 held-out variants (59 codons).
why: Candidate partial Ridge slightly worsened holdout MAE by 1.54% (0.189235 vs 0.186365 locked constant_dev_median MAE, rel=-0.015397 < 0.10) with Bonferroni 97.5% cluster-bootstrap CI [-0.038826, 0.036407] straddling zero. Standing: refuted.
